description:
List webhooks in a guild or channel.

Args:
  - guild_id (string, optional): List all webhooks in the server
  - channel_id (string, optional): List webhooks for a specific channel
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format

Returns:
  List of webhooks with name, channel, and URL

channel_id.description: Channel ID to list webhooks for a specific channel

guild_id.description: Guild ID to list all webhooks in the server

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_list_webhooks
title: List Webhooks
